title: flow_external_worker_job_bpmn_error input
description: Input for raising a BPMN error from an acquired external worker job. Unlike fail (a technical failure the engine retries) this is a MODELLED outcome: the process continues along the error boundary event that catches the given errorCode.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

errorCode.title: Error code
errorCode.description: The BPMN error code to raise; must match an errorEventDefinition in the process, otherwise the error escapes uncaught.

variables.description: Variables to set before the error is raised: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,value,type}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).
